name: veltravia-ai
description: Veltravia AI - an advanced AI software-development platform. Step 6: AI Agent Layer.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @veltravia/types && npm run build --workspace @veltravia/shared && npm run build --workspace @veltravia/config
scripts.build:ai: npm run build --workspace @veltravia/ai-core && npm run build --workspace @veltravia/ai-provider-mock && npm run build --workspace @veltravia/ai-provider-gemini
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:ai && npm run build:connectors && npm run build:tools && npm run build:agent && npm run build --workspace @veltravia/api && npm run build --workspace @veltravia/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run build:ai && npm run dev --workspace @veltravia/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @veltravia/web
scripts.build:connectors: npm run build --workspace @veltravia/connector-core && npm run build --workspace @veltravia/connector-mock
scripts.build:tools: npm run build --workspace @veltravia/tool-core && npm run build --workspace @veltravia/tool-mock
scripts.build:agent: npm run build --workspace @veltravia/agent-core && npm run build --workspace @veltravia/agent-mock
